summary: MaintCampus is a web-based screen for managing campus records in the HSPnet system. It allows administrators to view, add, edit, delete (inactivate), and reactivate campuses within their agency and department, supporting workflows for both local and system-wide administrators. The system ensures only authorized users can modify campuses, depending on their session and administrative roles, and includes validation and UI feedback for error, warning, and status conditions.
purpose: To provide a secure, user-friendly interface for authorized users to manage campus entities, including their names and short names, within the context of their agency and department. The screen facilitates CRUD operations on campuses, enforces permissions, and displays relevant feedback to the user.

workflows.name: Campus List and Filtering
steps: On page load, agency and department dropdowns are populated.
User selects department or agency; campus list is refreshed.
Checkbox allows showing inactive campuses.

workflows.name: Add Campus
steps: User clicks 'Add' button.
Screen switches to add mode; details popup is shown.
User enters data for Name, ShortName.
Validation: required fields.
Campus entity is created and added to DB.
Popup is closed, data is refreshed.

workflows.name: Edit Campus
steps: User clicks 'Edit' button for a campus.
Screen switches to edit mode; details popup is shown.
User modifies Name/ShortName fields.
Validation: required fields.
Campus entity is updated.
Popup is closed, data is refreshed.

workflows.name: Delete (Inactivate) Campus
steps: User clicks 'Delete' button for a campus.
Confirmation dialog is shown.
Campus is marked inactive.
Campus list is refreshed.

workflows.name: Reactivate Campus
steps: User clicks 'Reactivate' button for an inactive campus.
Campus is marked active.
Campus list is refreshed.

workflows.name: UI Feedback and Validation
steps: Validation summary displays errors.
Panels display warnings and errors as needed.
Edit/Add mode disables fields for view-only users.

business_rules: A campus must have a Name and ShortName specified.
Only administrators (System or Local) who are authorized via UserSession may edit/add/delete/reactivate campuses.
Department and Agency selections filter available campuses.
validations: Fields are disabled for non-editable screens.
Error and warning panels display relevant feedback.
conditions: Screen is editable only if UserSession is not view-only and is authorized as System or Local Administrator.
If CurrentAgencyID matches UserSession.AgencyID, department dropdown is auto-selected.
system_behavior: Panels and controls display/hide based on user actions and validation.
Campus details are shown in popups for add/edit.
Grid updates and reflects latest data after any operation.
dependencies: Dropdowns depend on Agencies and Departments data.
GridView depends on Campuses data filtered by department and agency.
exceptions: Invalid user session or insufficient access disables editing.
Invalid data entry prompts error panels.
No data found triggers No_Data_Press_Add message.
